copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 把消息渠道（如 Telegram、Slack）接到 agent 群组上：读取数据库查看当前接线状态、注册新渠道或新群组、设定隔离级别，也能重新调整已有接线。
howto.when: 当你新增了渠道、正在做初始化配置，或想单独重新配置渠道与 agent 群组的连接时它接管。

say.text: 看一下现在哪些渠道接好了、哪些还没接
say.note: 会读数据库并输出配置摘要

say.text: 把我的 Telegram 新群组接到 agent 群组上
say.note: 先问隔离问题，再执行注册

say.text: 把这个渠道改成独立 agent 的隔离级别
say.note: 会更新会话模式与接线

howto.what_en: Wires messaging channels to agent groups: reads the database to assess current state, registers new channels or channel groups, sets isolation levels, and reworks existing wiring.
howto.when_en: Takes over after you add a channel, during setup, or when you want to reconfigure channel-to-agent-group wiring.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are wired and which aren't.
say_en.note: Reads the DB, prints a config summary

say_en.text: Wire my new Telegram group to my agent group.
say_en.note: Asks the isolation question, then registers

say_en.text: Switch this channel to the separate-agent isolation level.
